subtitle: Your bills, consumption and energy costs in one place.
emptyDescription: Upload a ZeniΘ bill, review the extracted summary, and accept it. Only accepted bills appear here. Other formats can be entered manually.
localOnly: The PDF is read on your device. Only the accepted summary is stored; the original PDF is not retained.
summaryOnly: Saved summary · original PDF not retained
alreadyIncluded: These are included in supply charges. They are not added to the total again.
useSum: Use charge sum as current total
duplicate: This PDF or invoice has already been saved. Open the existing bill to review or correct it.
pdfRenderError: The PDF preview could not be displayed. Open the original file on your device to compare values.
recordedMonths_one: {{count}} issue month with bills · missing months excluded
recordedMonths_other: {{count}} issue months with bills · missing months excluded
issueMonthBasis: Current charges by invoice issue month, excluding carried balances. These are billed amounts, not confirmed payments.
allocationBasis: Estimated calendar allocation: each bill's kWh is spread evenly across its consumption dates. Actual readings replace overlapping estimates for the same supply.
costChartDescription: Monthly current-period invoice charges in EUR; missing months remain empty.
kwhChartDescription: Monthly consumption allocated by calendar days in kWh; missing months remain empty.
missingMonths: Empty months mean no recorded data, not zero usage or cost. Exact values are available below.
breakdownNote: From invoices issued in the selected year. Supply is after discounts and includes the fixed charge.
deleteConfirm: Delete this saved summary? This cannot be undone.
noInvoicesYear: No bills were issued in this year. Consumption may still be covered by a bill issued in another year.
needMoreYears: Add bills covering another year to compare your recorded costs and consumption.
comparisonNote: Recorded totals may cover different periods. Check coverage and daily use before comparing incomplete years; no annual savings are inferred.

warnings.unsupported: This provider or layout is not supported yet. Fill in the summary manually while comparing it with the PDF.
warnings.noText: This PDF has no readable text. Scanned-bill OCR is not available yet; you can enter the summary manually.
warnings.balanceDerived: The previous balance was calculated from the two printed totals. Check it against the PDF.
warnings.detailsMissing: An optional discount could not be identified reliably. Check the included details if needed.
warnings.invoiceMissing: Invoice number was not identified. Add it if available for duplicate detection.
warnings.incomplete: Some key values were not identified. Complete or correct the summary before accepting.

validation.identity: Enter a provider, supply identifier and bill type (maximum 100 characters per identifier).
validation.dates: Check the consumption dates, issue date and due date. The period must be valid and at most two years; issue must follow consumption and due date must follow issue.
validation.days: Enter 1–733 billing days, as printed on the bill.
validation.consumption: Enter valid, nonnegative kWh with at most three decimal places.
validation.amounts: Complete all amounts with at most two decimal places (within ±€1,000,000).
validation.sum: The charge breakdown does not match the current-period total. Compare the values with your PDF; discounts already included in supply must not be subtracted twice.
validation.balance: Current-period total plus previous balance must equal the amount due.
validation.details: Check the optional fixed charge and discount: fixed charge is nonnegative and discount is zero or negative.

importErrors.fileSize: Choose a PDF smaller than 15 MB.
importErrors.notPdf: This file is not a PDF. Select the original PDF bill.
importErrors.pageLimit: This document is too large to process here. Use a bill with at most 12 pages, or add its summary manually.
importErrors.failed: The PDF could not be read. It may be damaged or password-protected. Try an unlocked PDF or enter the summary manually.
